modules.title: 喂，你在做什麼呢？
modules.title_py: Wèi, nǐ zài zuò shén me ne?
modules.scene: Meimei phones Dawen in the evening. They ask each other what they are doing and promise to chat again later.
can_do: Say what is happening RIGHT NOW (我在上網呢)
Open and end a phone call (喂…／一會兒打電話給你)
Use the conversational particles 啊/呀/啦 naturally
modules.exam_link: Ongoing activities are the core of 聽力 Part 1 ('他在做什麼？'). The difference between 'is doing' vs 'usually' vs 'later' is often a distractor in 聽力 Part 2.

lines.zh: 喂，大文，你在做什麼呢？
lines.py: Wèi, Dà wén, nǐ zài zuò shén me ne?
lines.id: Hello, Dawen, what are you doing?

lines.zh: 我在上網呢。你呢？
lines.py: Wǒ zài shàng wǎng ne. Nǐ ne?
lines.id: I'm on the internet. And you?

lines.zh: 我正在看電影。你最近忙不忙？
lines.py: Wǒ zhèng zài kàn diàn yǐng. Nǐ zuì jìn máng bù máng?
lines.id: I'm watching a film. Have you been busy lately?

lines.zh: 最近很忙啊！每天都有很多功課。
lines.py: Zuì jìn hěn máng a! Měi tiān dōu yǒu hěn duō gōng kè.
lines.id: Really busy! Lots of homework every day.

lines.zh: 我們一會兒再聊吧！
lines.py: Wǒ men yí huìr zài liáo ba!
lines.id: Let's chat again later!

lines.zh: 好啊，等一下我打電話給你。
lines.py: Hǎo a, děng yí xià wǒ dǎ diàn huà gěi nǐ.
lines.id: OK, I'll call you in a bit.

lines.zh: 美美，你在跟誰聊天呀？
lines.py: Měi měi, nǐ zài gēn shéi liáo tiān ya?
lines.id: Meimei, who are you chatting with?

lines.zh: 我跟安妮在聊天啦。我們在聊一個網站。
lines.py: Wǒ gēn Ān ní zài liáo tiān la. Wǒ men zài liáo yí ge wǎng zhàn.
lines.id: I'm chatting with Annie. We're talking about a website.

lines.zh: 什麼網站？聊得很快樂。
lines.py: Shén me wǎng zhàn? Liáo de hěn kuài lè.
lines.id: What website? You're having a great chat.

lines.zh: 中文網站，聊到我的手機沒電啦！
lines.py: Zhōng wén wǎng zhàn, liáo dào wǒ de shǒu jī méi diàn la!
lines.id: A Chinese website. We chatted until my phone ran out of battery!

tasks.why: (1) 在 + V = to be doing. (2) a question with a question word + 呢. (3) an activity → 上網. 嗎 is not used together with 什麼.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 晚上八點，爸爸在看電視，媽媽在打電話，我在上網，妹妹在跟朋友聊天。
tasks.question: 誰在上網？
tasks.why: 我在上網 — the writer herself. Each family member does something different; match them one by one.

grammar.point: 在／正在 + V — to be doing
grammar.explain: 在 or 正在 before a verb = an action in progress. 正在 stresses 'right now'. Compare with 在1 (A08): 我在家 = I am at home (在 + place).

examples.id: I'm on the internet.
I'm chatting with Annie.

grammar.explain: 呢 at the end of a sentence softens questions with a question word (你在做什麼呢？) and stresses an ongoing situation (我在上網呢). Don't use it together with 嗎.

examples.id: So what are you up to?
I'm on the internet right now.

modules.title: 台北比雅加達冷。
modules.title_py: Tái běi bǐ Yǎ jiā dá lěng.
modules.scene: Dawen and Meimei compare cities: the weather in Taipei, Taichung and Jakarta, and where different places are on the map.
can_do: Compare with A 比 B + adjective (台北比雅加達冷)
Express similarity: A 跟 B 一樣 + adjective
Name the compass directions: 東、西、南、北
modules.exam_link: Comparison (比) is one of the most frequently tested patterns in 聽力 Parts 3–4 and 閱讀 Part 5 ('which is the most…?').

lines.zh: 美美，你覺得台北比雅加達熱嗎？
lines.py: Měi měi, nǐ jué de Tái běi bǐ Yǎ jiā dá rè ma?
lines.id: Meimei, do you think Taipei is hotter than Jakarta?

lines.zh: 很熱！雅加達比台北更熱。
lines.py: Hěn rè! Yǎ jiā dá bǐ Tái běi gèng rè.
lines.id: It's hot! But Jakarta is even hotter than Taipei.

lines.zh: 那台北跟台中一樣熱嗎？
lines.py: Nà Tái běi gēn Tái zhōng yí yàng rè ma?
lines.id: Then is Taipei as hot as Taichung?

lines.zh: 不一樣。台中比台北熱。
lines.py: Bù yí yàng. Tái zhōng bǐ Tái běi rè.
lines.id: Not the same. Taichung is hotter than Taipei.

dialogs.title_id: Looking at a map of the school

lines.zh: 你看這張圖：我們學校在書店南邊。
lines.py: Nǐ kàn zhè zhāng tú: wǒ men xué xiào zài shū diàn nán biān.
lines.id: Look at this map: our school is south of the bookshop.

lines.zh: 我們學校的東邊是公園嗎？
lines.py: Wǒ men xué xiào de dōng biān shì gōng yuán ma?
lines.id: Is the park east of our school?

lines.zh: 對。我們學校的東邊是公園，西邊是火車站。
lines.py: Duì. Wǒ men xué xiào de dōng biān shì gōng yuán, xī biān shì huǒ chē zhàn.
lines.id: Yes. East of our campus is the park, and west is the train station.

lines.zh: 火車站的聲音比公園大，我比較喜歡公園！
lines.py: Huǒ chē zhàn de shēng yīn bǐ gōng yuán dà, wǒ bǐ jiào xǐ huān gōng yuán!
lines.id: The station is louder than the park — I prefer the park!

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 台北（1）雅加達冷。台北跟台中不（2）。雅加達比台北（3）熱。
tasks.why: (1) A比B + Vs. (2) 跟…不一樣. (3) 更 strengthens the comparison (even more …). 跟 is already in the second sentence.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 安妮家在雅加達，美美家在台中。雅加達比台中熱，台中比台北熱。
tasks.question: 哪裡最冷？
tasks.why: Jakarta > Taichung > Taipei (in heat). The coldest: Taipei — you have to infer it from two comparisons.

grammar.point: A 比 B + Vs — A is more … than B
grammar.explain: The comparison pattern: A 比 B + adjective. DON'T use 很 before the adjective (台北比雅加達很冷 ✗); to intensify use 更 (更熱), or 比較 for 'somewhat more'.

examples.id: Taipei is colder than Jakarta.
Jakarta is much hotter than Taipei.

grammar.point: A 跟 B 一樣 (+Vs) — A is as … as B
grammar.explain: 跟…一樣 = the same as; add an adjective for the aspect that is the same: 一樣貴 (just as expensive). Negative: 跟…不一樣 (different).

examples.id: This one is as expensive as that one.
Taipei is different from Taichung.

modules.title: 這件外套太大了。
modules.title_py: Zhè jiàn wài tào tài dà le.
modules.scene: As winter approaches, Dawen tries on jackets and coats at a clothes shop with Meimei; the sizes don't fit and the prices are a bit high.
can_do: Complain with 太 + adjective + 了 (太大了)
Say 'a bit (too)' with 有(一)點 + adjective
Name clothes & accessories: 外套、帽子、眼鏡、手錶
modules.exam_link: Complaints about size/price (太大了、有點貴) are a FREQUENT pattern in 聽力 Parts 3–4; the answer is often implied ('nice, but a bit expensive' = not buying).

lines.zh: 大文，你試這件外套吧。
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ shì zhè jiàn wài tào ba.
lines.id: Dawen, try this jacket on.

lines.zh: 這件外套太大了！
lines.py: Zhè jiàn wài tào tài dà le!
lines.id: This jacket's too big!

lines.zh: 那件大衣呢？
lines.py: Nà jiàn dà yī ne?
lines.id: What about that coat?

lines.zh: 那件有點小，還有一點貴。
lines.py: Nà jiàn yǒu diǎn xiǎo, hái yǒu yì diǎn guì.
lines.id: That one is a bit small, and also a bit expensive.

lines.zh: 這個帽子很好看，你戴一下。
lines.py: Zhè ge mào zi hěn hǎo kàn, nǐ dài yí xià.
lines.id: This hat looks nice, try it on.

lines.zh: 太好了，不大也不小。
lines.py: Tài hǎo le, bú dà yě bù xiǎo.
lines.id: Great, it's not too big and not too small.

lines.zh: 今天下大雨了。
lines.py: Jīn tiān xià dà yǔ le.
lines.id: It's raining heavily today.

lines.zh: 對，你的褲子和我的裙子都濕了。
lines.py: Duì, nǐ de kù zi hé wǒ de qún zi dōu shī le.
lines.id: Yes, your trousers and my skirt are both wet.

lines.zh: 你的手錶也濕了。
lines.py: Nǐ de shǒu biǎo yě shī le.
lines.id: Your watch is wet too.

lines.zh: 對啊！我的眼鏡在哪裡？
lines.py: Duì a! Wǒ de yǎn jìng zài nǎ lǐ?
lines.id: Right! Where are my glasses?

lines.zh: 不是你放在書包裡了嗎？
lines.py: Bú shì nǐ fàng zài shū bāo lǐ le ma?
lines.id: Didn't you put them in your schoolbag?

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 這件外套太大（1）。那件有（2）小。你（3）這件吧！
tasks.why: (1) 太…了. (2) 有點小. (3) 試 = to try. 脫 (to take off) doesn't fit the context of trying on clothes.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 今天太熱了，我不穿外套，也不戴帽子。可是我戴眼鏡和手錶。

tasks.why: 戴眼鏡和手錶. 帽子 is negated; 外套 is worn with 穿 and is also negated.

grammar.explain: 太…了 = too … (usually a complaint). It can also be a positive exclamation: 太好了！ (great!). 了 usually goes at the end.

examples.id: This jacket's too big!
The weather's too hot.

grammar.explain: 有(一)點 BEFORE an adjective = a bit …, usually for something undesirable: 有點貴, 有點小. Don't confuse it with Vs一點 (B21), used to ask for 'a bit more …'.

examples.id: That one's a bit small, and a bit expensive too.

modules.title: 往前走，到路口右轉。
modules.title_py: Wǎng qián zǒu, dào lù kǒu yòu zhuǎn.
modules.title_id: Go straight ahead and turn right at the junction.
modules.scene: Dawen looks for the city library and gets step-by-step directions; that evening he phones Meimei after getting back to the dorm.
can_do: Understand step-by-step directions: 往前走、到路口右轉、經過…
Express the direction of movement: 從…往…
Say where an action ends up: V到／V在 (走到、放在)
modules.exam_link: Step-by-step directions are a typical 聽力 Part 3 question ('at which junction do you turn?') and appear in 閱讀 Part 3.

lines.zh: 小姐，請問，圖書館怎麼走？
lines.py: Xiǎo jiě, qǐng wèn, tú shū guǎn zěn me zǒu?
lines.id: Excuse me, miss, how do I get to the library?

lines.zh: 你從這裡往前走，到路口右轉。
lines.py: Nǐ cóng zhè lǐ wǎng qián zǒu, dào lù kǒu yòu zhuǎn.
lines.id: From here go straight ahead, and turn right at the junction.

lines.zh: 第一個路口嗎？
lines.py: Dì-yī ge lù kǒu ma?
lines.id: The first junction?

lines.zh: 不是，第二個十字路口。你會經過一個公園。
lines.py: Bú shì, dì-èr ge shí zì lù kǒu. Nǐ huì jīng guò yí ge gōng yuán.
lines.id: No, the second crossroads. You'll pass a park.

lines.zh: 我走到公園，就往右轉，對嗎？
lines.py: Wǒ zǒu dào gōng yuán, jiù wǎng yòu zhuǎn, duì ma?
lines.id: I walk to the park and then turn right, is that it?

lines.zh: 對。圖書館在公園對面。
lines.py: Duì. Tú shū guǎn zài gōng yuán duì miàn.
lines.id: That's right. The library is opposite the park.

lines.zh: 大文，你回到宿舍了嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ huí dào sù shè le ma?
lines.id: Dawen, are you back at the dorm?

lines.zh: 回到了宿舍。怎麼了？
lines.py: Huí dào le sù shè. Zěn me le?
lines.id: I'm back at the dorm. What's up?

lines.zh: 沒事，從你們宿舍向左轉，是不是有一家超商？
lines.py: Méi shì, cóng nǐ men sù shè xiàng zuǒ zhuǎn, shì bú shì yǒu yì jiā chāo shāng?
lines.id: Nothing much. If you turn left from your dorm, is there a convenience store?

lines.zh: 有，非常大的一家超商。
lines.py: Yǒu, fēi cháng dà de yì jiā chāo shāng.
lines.id: Yes, there's a really big convenience store.

tasks.why: 經過兩個路口 (pass two) → turn at 第三個. 兩 is a number trap.

grammar.pattern: 從 + place + 往 + direction + V
grammar.explain: 往 + direction before a verb = to move in that direction (往前、往右、往北). With 從 in front for the starting point: 從這裡往前走.

examples.id: From here go straight ahead.
From the park walk north for five minutes.

grammar.explain: 到/在 right after a verb shows where the action ENDS UP: 走到公園 (walk to the park), 回到宿舍 (get back to the dorm), 放在桌子上 (put on the table), 住在台北.

examples.id: I walk to the park and then turn right.

modules.title: 我是坐飛機來的。
modules.title_py: Wǒ shì zuò fēi jī lái de.
modules.scene: Annie asks how Dawen first came to Taiwan; then Dawen tells Meimei about his trip to Taichung.
can_do: Stress when/how/with whom something happened: 是…的
Say an action is completed, with an amount: V了 + amount (住了三天)
Tell a travel story: 本來…、以為…、剛剛…
modules.exam_link: 是…的 and V了 are the core patterns of experience stories in 聽力 Part 4 and 閱讀 Part 4 (first-person narrative paragraphs).

lines.zh: 大文，你是什麼時候來臺灣的？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ shì shén me shí hòu lái Tái wān de?
lines.id: Dawen, when did you come to Taiwan?

lines.zh: 我是去年九月來的。
lines.py: Wǒ shì qù nián jiǔ yuè lái de.
lines.id: I came last September.

lines.zh: 你是坐飛機來的嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ shì zuò fēi jī lái de ma?
lines.id: Did you come by plane?

lines.zh: 當然是坐飛機來的！我從雅加達坐了五個小時。
lines.py: Dāng rán shì zuò fēi jī lái de! Wǒ cóng Yǎ jiā dá zuò le wǔ ge xiǎo shí.
lines.id: By plane, of course! From Jakarta I sat for five hours.

lines.zh: 你是一個人來的嗎？
lines.py: Nǐ shì yí ge rén lái de ma?
lines.id: Did you come alone?

lines.zh: 不是，我是跟我姊姊一起來的。
lines.py: Bú shì, wǒ shì gēn wǒ jiě jie yì qǐ lái de.
lines.id: No, I came with my older sister.

lines.zh: 大文，你已經去過很多地方旅行了嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ yǐ jīng qù guò hěn duō dì fāng lǚ xíng le ma?
lines.id: Dawen, have you been to lots of places?

lines.zh: 我剛剛從台中回來。我本來以為台中很遠，可是坐火車很快。
lines.py: Wǒ gāng gāng cóng Tái zhōng huí lái. Wǒ běn lái yǐ wéi Tái zhōng hěn yuǎn, kě shì zuò huǒ chē hěn kuài.
lines.id: I've just got back from Taichung. I thought Taichung was far, but it turned out to be quick by train.

lines.zh: 你去了幾天？
lines.py: Nǐ qù le jǐ tiān?
lines.id: How many days did you go for?

lines.zh: 我去了三天，看了很多地方。我只會說幾句中文，可是大家好像都懂！
lines.py: Wǒ qù le sān tiān, kàn le hěn duō dì fāng. Wǒ zhǐ huì shuō jǐ jù Zhōng wén, kě shì dà jiā hǎo xiàng dōu dǒng!
lines.id: Three days — I saw lots of places. I can only say a few sentences in Mandarin, but everyone seemed to understand!

lines.zh: 在台中有去夜市嗎？
lines.py: Zài Tái zhōng yǒu qù yè shì ma?
lines.id: Did you go to a night market in Taichung?

lines.zh: 有！我在夜市吃了很多小吃，還交了新朋友。
lines.py: Yǒu! Wǒ zài yè shì chī le hěn duō xiǎo chī, hái jiāo le xīn péng yǒu.
lines.id: Yes! I ate lots of snacks at the night market and made a new friend.

tasks.why: 是……的 stresses the MANNER: 坐飛機來的.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.
tasks.question: 你是怎麼來的？
tasks.why: 坐火車來的 = came by train.

tasks.question: 他在哪裡？
tasks.why: 剛剛 = just now. The chair is still empty, and the person is seen going out of the door.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: 是怎麼來的 asks HOW someone came (a past event) → 是 + manner + 來的.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the sentence, then choose the most suitable response.
tasks.audio: 你是什麼時候來臺灣的？
tasks.why: Asked WHEN → a time. B answers HOW.

lines.zh: 你今天是怎麼來學校的？
我是坐公車來的。
我以為你騎腳踏車來。
今天下雨，所以坐公車。

tasks.question: 這位小姐今天怎麼來學校的？
tasks.why: 我是坐公車來的 (because of the rain). B: the man's wrong assumption (以為). C is not mentioned.

tasks.instr: Listen to the dialogue, then choose the correct answer.

lines.zh: 妳是一個人來的嗎？
不是，我本來想一個人來，可是我媽媽跟我一起來了。

tasks.question: 這位小姐是跟誰來的？
tasks.why: 本來想一個人 (the original plan) → in fact her mother came along. A = the 本來 trap.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 我已經吃了三個包子。
tasks.why: V了 + amount = has done … this much.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: 旅行 = to travel.

tasks.why: 以為 = to (wrongly) think.

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: 我（1）去年來臺灣的。我是坐飛機來（2）。我在台北（3）了兩個月。
tasks.why: (1)+(2) 是…的 frames the time of arrival. (3) 住了兩個月. 已經 doesn't fit any blank.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 我去年七月去臺南旅行。我是坐火車去的，在臺南住了四天，吃了很多小吃。
tasks.question: 他在臺南住了幾天？
tasks.why: 住了四天. 七 is the month of the trip.

grammar.point: (是)…的 — stressing details of a past event
grammar.pattern: S + 是 + when/how/with whom + V + 的
grammar.explain: When the event is already known to have happened, 是…的 is used to ask about/stress its DETAILS: when, where, how, with whom. Negative: 不是…的. 是 can be dropped in positive sentences.

examples.id: I came last September.

examples.zh: 我是跟我姊姊一起來的。
examples.id: I came with my older sister.

check.q: Asking how someone came (it has happened):

grammar.explain: 了 right after a verb = the action is COMPLETE, usually followed by a specific amount/object: 住了三天, 看了很多地方, 坐了五個小時. Different from sentence-final 了 (B09), which marks a change of state.

examples.zh: 我去了三天，看了很多地方。
examples.id: I went for three days and saw lots of places.
Stayed four days in Tainan.

modules.title: 因為我感冒了，所以今天不能上課。
modules.title_py: Yīn wèi wǒ gǎn mào le, suǒ yǐ jīn tiān bù néng shàng kè.
modules.title_id: Because I have the flu, I can't come to class today.
modules.scene: Dawen asks the teacher for leave from class because of flu, then Meimei visits him and advises him about his sleeping habits.
can_do: Give reasons & results: 因為…，所以…
Express contrast: 但是／不過／雖然
Politely ask for leave from class
modules.exam_link: 因為…所以… and 雖然…但是… are among the most frequently tested patterns in 聽力 Parts 3–4 and 閱讀 Parts 4–5 (cause-and-effect & contrast).

lines.zh: 陳老師，對不起，因為我感冒了，所以今天不能上課。
lines.py: Chén lǎo shī, duì bù qǐ, yīn wèi wǒ gǎn mào le, suǒ yǐ jīn tiān bù néng shàng kè.
lines.id: Ms Chen, I'm sorry — because I have the flu, I can't come today.

lines.zh: 沒關係，你的健康最重要。你要多休息。
lines.py: Méi guān xi, nǐ de jiàn kāng zuì zhòng yào. Nǐ yào duō xiū xí.
lines.id: That's all right; your health is the most important thing. Get plenty of rest.

lines.zh: 謝謝老師。但是明天有考試……
lines.py: Xiè xie lǎo shī. Dàn shì míng tiān yǒu kǎo shì…
lines.id: Thank you. But there's an exam tomorrow…

lines.zh: 你好了才來上課，以後再考試。
lines.py: Nǐ hǎo le cái lái shàng kè, yǐ hòu zài kǎo shì.
lines.id: Just come back to class once you're better; you can take the exam later.

lines.zh: 大文，你好一點了嗎？
lines.py: Dà wén, nǐ hǎo yì diǎn le ma?
lines.id: Dawen, are you feeling a bit better?

lines.zh: 好一點了，不過還很累。
lines.py: Hǎo yì diǎn le, bú guò hái hěn lèi.
lines.id: A bit better, but I still feel weak.

lines.zh: 因為你每天很晚睡覺，所以常常生病。
lines.py: Yīn wèi nǐ měi tiān hěn wǎn shuì jiào, suǒ yǐ cháng cháng shēng bìng.
lines.id: Because you go to bed late every day, you often get ill.

lines.zh: 雖然很忙，但是以後我要早一點睡覺。
lines.py: Suī rán hěn máng, dàn shì yǐ hòu wǒ yào zǎo yì diǎn shuì jiào.
lines.id: Even though I'm busy, from now on I'll go to bed earlier.

picture.label: he has the flu and is lying down at home

tasks.question: 她為什麼在家？
tasks.why: 因為……(所以)…… = because … so …. Tissues & a thermometer → 感冒.

tasks.instr: Look at the picture. Listen to the question and answers A–C, then choose the answer that matches the picture.

tasks.question: 你幾點起床？
tasks.why: 才 = only then (late). 十一點才起床 = didn't get up until 11.

tasks.part: 聽力 Part 2 · One-turn question & answer
tasks.instr: Listen to the question, then choose the most suitable answer.
tasks.why: 為什麼 → answer with 因為 + a reason. C uses 所以 with the opposite meaning.

現在好了嗎？

tasks.question: 這位小姐昨天為什麼沒來上課？
tasks.why: 因為我感冒了，所以昨天沒來. B & C are not mentioned.

那我們去別的店吧。

tasks.question: 這位先生覺得衣服怎麼樣？
tasks.why: 但是 introduces the more important information (too expensive) → they go to another shop.

tasks.instr: Read the sentence, then choose the matching picture.
tasks.text: 因為下雨，所以我們不去公園。

options.label: raining, still going to the park

tasks.why: 因為…所以… = because …, so ….

tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the matching sentence.
tasks.why: 健康 = healthy.

tasks.part: 閱讀 Part 3 · Gap fill with picture
tasks.instr: Look at the picture, then choose the right word for the blank.
tasks.text: 雖然下雨，（　）我還是去學校。
tasks.why: The partner of 雖然 is 但是/可是.

tasks.instr: Choose the right word for each blank. ONE option is not used.
tasks.text: （1）我感冒了，（2）今天不能上課。雖然很累，（3）我明天要考試。
tasks.why: (1)+(2) 因為…所以…. (3) 雖然…但是…. 才 doesn't fit any blank.

tasks.instr: Read the text, then choose the correct answer.
tasks.text: 王大文昨天感冒了，所以今天不能上課。醫生說他要多休息，好了才能去學校。
tasks.question: 大文什麼時候才能去學校？
tasks.why: 好了才能去學校 = can only go to school AFTER getting better. 才 = only then (once the condition is met).

grammar.explain: The reason comes first with 因為, the result after it with 所以. In Mandarin both CAN be used together (unlike English, which normally chooses one).

examples.zh: 因為我感冒了，所以今天不能上課。
examples.id: Because I have the flu, I can't come today.

examples.zh: 因為你每天很晚睡覺，所以常常生病。
examples.id: Because you go to bed late every day, you often get ill.

grammar.explain: 但是 = but (a little firmer/more formal than 可是); 不過 is softer. The information after 但是 is usually the more IMPORTANT part — watch for it in 聽力 questions.

examples.zh: 這件衣服很漂亮，但是太貴了。
examples.id: This top is pretty, but it's too expensive.
A bit better, but I still feel weak.

check.q: 'He's tall, but he can't play basketball' =

但是他很高，不會打籃球。
他很高但是，不會打籃球。
